metadata.description: The AI and communication layer for running the business, with Odoo as the system of record: one setup for every role, plain-English assistants for CRM leads, notes and business reporting, shared brand skills, and the admin control plane.

plugins.name: systemprompt-commons
plugins.description: Shared brand skills: voice, document formatting, client email, and company boilerplate

plugins.name: systemprompt-user
plugins.description: Run the business from the conversation with Odoo as the system of record: create, update, and report on CRM leads, log notes onto records, and pull a live business overview — every action executed in Odoo as the acting user.

plugins.name: systemprompt-admin
plugins.description: Admin-only control plane: who is using the platform, what it costs, what failed, and why. Ships the systemprompt CLI server plus governance, analytics, and operations skills, and three live dashboards.

plugins.name: systemprompt-demo
plugins.description: The staged enterprise demo (DEMO.md): five skills, easy to hard, walking lead triage, an account 360, governed CRM writes, the trust layer tripped on purpose, and the metered bill for the whole run — the Agentforce comparison with live numbers.
